topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: I've always known the woods well, but never guessed the depth of what lay beneath the old oak by the stream. My paws have traced these paths since the dawn of my days, yet only now do I see the true richness of the land I've roamed. The berries are plumper, the stream clearer, and the shelter of my den more grand than I once perceived. Others pass by, unseeing, their noses to the ground, but I, with every step, feel the amassed bounty of this place. My gaze scans the horizon, not just for the next meal, but for the vast tapestry of life that thrives under my watch.
